outputs.explanation: Spatial deconvolution plots are heatmap-style visualizations (color-coded values overlaid on tissue spots), which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Box plots showing fraction of cells for each immune population already display individual data points (dots) overlaid on the boxes for both T11b-high LUSC and LUAD groups.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots, which are exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.

Each bar represents a single computed differential-expression statistic (log2 fold change per gene) with an associated p-value, not a mean/median calculated across replicate samples for that gene, so individual data point overlay is not applicable here.
This panel consists of representative H&E and IHC micrographs, not a quantitative plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
